summary: E2E-verified the 3 MOD Fault Wizard changes on the live preview. Logged in as test@army.mod.test at /MODService, opened wizard via 'Report a fault' CTA, picked a machine, chose fault type 'noise', entered 36-char description, filled the new 'Any steps taken to fix?' textarea (data-testid mod-field-steps-taken), uploaded a JPG through the hidden gallery input, picked a reporter, and submitted. All acceptance criteria PASS.
verified_acceptance_criteria: Description counter renders '36 / 30 minimum' (30-char minimum shown).
With a 30-39 char description, mod-wizard-next Continue is enabled (disabled=false observed at 36 chars).
New optional field mod-field-steps-taken is present, typing works, value persisted to textarea state.

Attachments step: POST /api/mod/site/attachments returned 200; mod-attachment-0 rendered an whose src is a blob: object URL with naturalWidth=200, naturalHeight=200, complete=true (thumbnail preview NOT blank).
Submit posted to POST /api/mod/site/faults and returned 200 (NOT 422). Confirmation screen shown with ticket ref 'MOD-2026-34010'.
Payload sent by wizard includes steps_taken (verified in /app/frontend/src/pages/MODPortal/MODFaultWizard.js lines 176 & 198).
IssueDetailPanel.js lines 616-619 renders {issue.steps_taken} conditionally — will display the entered text on the fault detail view.
critical_code_review_comments: StepAttachments correctly creates a local URL.createObjectURL(payload) as 'preview' and falls back to serve URL — good, this insulates the thumbnail from token/CSP issues.
MODFaultWizard sends steps_taken as '' when empty (md.steps_taken || '') — backend FaultSubmit accepts empty string.
Note: existing dashboard-list search finds description text; the new fault appears in the reactive faults list immediately.
test_credentials: test@army.mod.test / ModTest123! (MOD Test Site) — sign in at /MODService
seed_data_creation: One fault ticket MOD-2026-34010 was created against PF-MODTS-006 (Pulse Fitness Fusion Dual Adjustable Pulley) with description 'Belt slipping badly on incline mode.' and steps_taken 'Powered off and on, tightened the belt slightly.' Reporter: Cpl James Reed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Fault Wizard changes (thumbnail preview, 30-char minimum, steps_taken optional field) are verified live. The PWA install prompt overlays the dashboard on desktop viewport — dismiss it via 'Later' button before opening the wizard, otherwise machine tile clicks can be intercepted. Note /api/auth/login rejects MOD accounts with 403 requiring /MODService login flow.
